product_metadata.title: Siveit CD Case holder, 80 Capacity CD/DVD Case Holders Wallet Hard Plastic CD DVD Disc Cases Storage Binder for Car Home Office Travel (Grey)
features: Large Capacity: Siveit CD case can store 80 CDs/DVDs and keep them well organized, saving you more space. With 15 color choices, you can choose the color you like and store CDs into several categories by color.

Strong & Durable: Siveit CD/DVD case is made of hard durable plastic, PP film with non-woven fabric material. It can store your CDs/DVDs for a long time and protect damage from dust, moisture, and scratches.

High Quality: To effectively protect CD and DVD discs, we tested PP films and non-woven fabrics of different thicknesses and chose the most suitable thickness to ensure long-term use without scratching the disc. The zipper is smooth and easy to use, it can be easily closed after 80 CDs are filled.

Easy to Use: Each slot has a slide lock to prevent your CDs/DVDs from sliding out. We removed the redundant T-shaped edge material in the slot so you can store cs/dvd directly. Note: T-shaped edge materials are removed manually. Please understand if there are some individual materials.

Service Guarantee: A high-quality product is often reflected in every detail of the product, and an excellent business is often reflected in customer service. If you are not satisfied with the product, please contact us for a refund.
